documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our facilities management team requested discovery about regional coordination. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves contradictory project status information, specifically that the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This creates uncertainty about the need for a discovery meeting or integration requirements.

claims.quote: Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that there is conflicting information regarding the project status and requirements. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify whether the project is currently paused and if there is agreement on the requirement for regional coordination? This will help us proceed effectively.
questions: Could you confirm whether the project is paused and whether there is agreement on the requirement for regional coordination?
What specific concerns does the owner have about the requirement for regional coordination?
uncertainties: The project status and whether the owner agrees on the requirement for regional coordination.
